posts.author: Zhyren
posts.body:
Hello! I wanted to know if it was possible to when the mouse hovers over a picture the picture would then darken a bit to represent that it’s been hover on, but when it’s no longer having the mouse hover over the picture it would no longer darken.
This question is more so based the hover mechanic, like, is it possible to get the picture to change when the mouse is hovered on?
